dedupe_keys.name: georisk portal of natural disaster risks in benin

description: GeoRisk is the Benin portal on natural disaster risks, run by the Ministry of Living Environment and Transport. Its data page lists national reference layers (borders, the 12 departments, 77 communes and prefectures, 5,541 towns, villages and neighbourhoods, river basins, the road network from OpenStreetMap, the national cadastre of the land agency ANDF, national parks, a 30 metre SRTM terrain model and permanent rivers) and a natural hazard layer of flood-prone zones of Benin. These are served through WMS, WMTS and WFS endpoints on a GeoServer, and the portal also integrates third-party WMS layers: a 100-year flood hazard map from the Global Flood Database, UNOSAT rapid flood mapping, global river flood hazard depths, CHIRPS monthly rainfall, 24-hour MODIS fires from NASA FIRMS, ESA WorldCover 2021, FAO GIEWS NDVI, a Meta population raster and Landsat 7 surface temperature. Maps, documents and commune pages are also offered. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): licence set per resource in the GeoRisk Bénin metadata (reuse must cite GeoRisk Bénin / MCVT). Access is free of charge. Caveats: many layers are copies or services of global products, and the date of the national flood zone layer is not given. Coverage is Benin. It supports flood exposure analysis of roads, settlements and land parcels; related records are InaRISK of Indonesia and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
